developments.title: Auto-transcribed TikTok: How to Achieve Anything - The 5 Pillars of Success
developments.description: Transcribed TikTok from @thedankoe. Key message: 5 pillars for achieving anything in life - (1) Clear Vision: most people don't know what they want because they haven't reflected on what they don't want for years; (2) Daily Learning: true learning is painful, not about memorization or grades; (3) Daily Building: most people don't build, they dabble - chasing dopamine hits from initial progress then quitting when it flatlines; (4) Persistence: most people give up before the breakthrough; (5) Iteration: most people don't improve when they fail - they get discouraged and lose the mental battle between their lower self and higher self. Core message: Don't be most people.
developments.expectedImprovement: New motivational transcript added covering the 5 essential pillars for achieving success - vision, learning, building, persistence, and iteration

developments.title: Auto-transcribed TikTok: The Next AI Wave is All About Context & Knowledge Management
developments.description: Transcribed TikTok from @nate.b.jones. Key thesis: 2025 was 'vibe coding', early 2026 is all about AI agents (long-running agentic work), and the NEXT wave (April-June 2026) will be all about DATA CONTEXT and KNOWLEDGE MANAGEMENT. Predicts 'piles and piles of startups' focused on helping agents get the data context right. Core insight: agents need to operate on detailed context from meetings, SharePoint, Notes apps, etc. to give extraordinary results. The new paradigm: you're not a Mac/Windows/Android/iOS person—you're an 'agent person.' Best preparation: GET YOUR NOTES IN ORDER. The context you give to LLM determines your success with AI agents in 2026.
developments.expectedImprovement: New transcript added covering the next wave of AI: context management and knowledge organization as the key differentiator for agent success

developments.title: Standardized all thumbnails to 180x320 portrait (9:16)
developments.description: Regenerated all 9 transcript thumbnails to consistent 180x320 portrait aspect ratio using ffmpeg. Previously mixed: t-005/t-009 were portrait (180x320), t-006/t-007/t-008/t-010/t-011/t-012/t-013 were landscape (320x180). Used scale+pad filter to convert landscape to portrait with padding. Updated CSS to use aspectRatio: 9/16 and objectFit: cover. All thumbnails now display uniformly without stretching.
developments.expectedImprovement: All transcript thumbnails identical 9:16 portrait ratio - consistent, clean display, no stretching issues.

developments.title: Fixed thumbnail stretching: natural aspect ratios with object-fit contain
developments.description: Fixed thumbnail display to handle mixed aspect ratios properly. Removed fixed aspect-ratio constraint. Now uses: width 100px, height auto, maxHeight 180px, object-fit contain. Portrait thumbnails (180x320 like t-005, t-009) display full height without stretching. Landscape thumbnails (320x180 like t-006, t-007, t-008) display within bounds without distortion. All images show completely without cropping or stretching.
developments.expectedImprovement: All transcript thumbnails display in their natural aspect ratio - no stretching, no distortion, no cropping. Portrait and landscape images both look correct.
